title: polylobium erubescens
intro: Polylobium erubescens, commonly known as the "Pink Shower Tree", is a species of flowering plant in the family Polygalaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Polylobium erubescens include reducing fever, relieving pain, and treating various gastrointestinal issues.
